description: Harness install updates an installed harness. `runHarnessInstall` in `.agro/cli/src/commands/harness.ts` probes the harness in the sandbox. If the probe passes and the marker `share/agro/harnesses/<id>.installed` exists, the command prints `already installed` and returns 0. `installOnHost` has the same early return. "Updating a harness" in `docs/harnesses/overview.md` says that the command installs the latest version. Each catalog install command installs the latest version, for example `npm --prefix <prefix> install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code`. The fix removes the early return for a harness that AGRO installed, so the command runs the install command again.

userStories.title: Run the install again for an installed harness
userStories.description: As a sandbox user, I want `agro harness install <id>` to update an installed harness, so that the command matches the docs.
acceptanceCriteria: In the sandbox, if the harness binary and the install marker exist, `agro harness install <id>` prints `updating <title> in the sandbox…`. The command then runs the install command of the catalog entry again.

On the host, if the host config records the harness, `agro harness install <id>` runs the install command again. If a binary exists outside the AGRO prefix without a record, the command still prints `already installed` and changes nothing.
For `hermes`, the update path keeps the configuration step.
The section "Updating a harness" in `docs/harnesses/overview.md` states this behavior.
Tests in `.agro/cli/src/__tests__/harness.test.ts` cover the command for an installed harness in the sandbox and on the host. The tests fail before the fix.
userStories.notes: AC1 executed: harness.test.ts 'runs the install again for a harness AGRO installed' red before (pi: already installed), green after; exe.dev VM: branch build printed 'updating Pi in the sandbox…' and npm changed 121 packages. AC2 executed: host record test red before, green after; existing test for a binary outside the prefix without a record still prints already installed. AC3 executed: hermes update test checks configure after install.sh. AC4 executed: overview.md, installation.md, hermes.md updated; ste-check exit 0 on each. AC5 executed: tests failed before the fix (3 failed). AC6 executed: advisor reran pnpm test:scripts exit 0 (1939 passed, 2 skipped) and pnpm typecheck exit 0. Repair commit 4eb2d830 updated hermes-integration.test.ts and two docs claims outside the first owned paths.

userStories.title: Record the manual review on a new VM
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I want a transcript from a new exe.dev VM, so that I can see the update run.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/tasks/harness-install-update/evidence/manual-review.md` holds the transcript of two runs of `agro harness install pi` in the sandbox, before and after the fix.
The advisor destroys the VM after the run, and no `agro-matrix` VM remains on exe.dev.
userStories.notes: AC1 executed: evidence/manual-review.md, exedev-repro.log, and exedev-after.txt hold the release and branch runs of agro harness install pi. AC2 executed: ssh exe.dev rm printed '1 VM deleted successfully', agro-matrix count 0 (KEEP=1 run, count checked by hand).
